script: I thought I saved my mom—then she vanished, and now I am terrified.. I got my mom's flight tickets booked back in June, and she was supposed to leave yesterday. I've been zero contact for almost four years—only the sister, the guy with Power of Attorney, and now, oddly, her boyfriend in England—so I didn't even know she'd canceled her trip at the last minute. He'd paid extra for a wheelchair and a flight attendant to help her, but she just said she was too weak to make it through the airport. Classic "tomorrow is another day" attitude. Today the guy with Power of Attorney pulled up at the townhouse and handed her an eviction notice. She's on a month‑to‑month lease, so 30 days' notice is enough. My dad's name's on the lease too, but he's not living there, so they can remove him. Since she can't legally stay, it's over. The landlord had wanted her out long ago, but he kept delaying it to let her go back to England while still paying the rent through my dad's account. Now she's run out of chances. I am in a different state with my daughter, who's recovering and actually walking again—she's a total champ. My mother‑in‑law is home with the other kids, and she's a fierce woman who raised my husband. I am not about to drag her into our lives or pay for her. I am not about to let her ruin what I've built for my kids. So here I am, eating popcorn while all this happens, and honestly, I am not feeling sorry for the mother who's going to be homeless. The audacity. (I know, right?)
